description.en: Creates a "bust-up" portrait (the close-up upper-body character art shown during dialogue) for a character model handle, returning its handle.
Character model handle to create the bust-up from.
Internal name for the bust-up instance.
Optional; whether the bust-up should appear automatically when its character talks.
Optional NPC index, used when the bust-up is for a generic NPC slot.

example.code:
// Create a talking NPC's bust-up portrait
local bustupHdl = CMND_CREATE_BUSTUP(npcHdl, "talk\x008a\x00e7");
